cheatsheet.title: Open and read the Sirius diagrams

intro.description: Learn where the graphical representations live and what the KIDE visual language means.

item.title: Open the representations file
item.description: Open com.mncml/representations.aird. Expand the viewpoints and double-click a representation to open it.

item.title: Enable the viewpoints
item.description: If nothing is listed, use Viewpoint Selection and tick ActivityFlowDiagrams and the MNC viewpoints.

item.title: Read the colours
item.description: Blue is a capability, amber is an activity, green is data or a parameter, slate is an MNC structural element. Borders and labels follow the same palette everywhere.

item.title: Follow the edges
item.description: Grey connectors carry flow, dashed connectors carry a binding between a capability and a resource. Labels sit at the centre of every connector.

item.title: Keep the text and the diagram in sync
item.description: Edit the textual model and save. The diagram refreshes on the next open, or immediately with the live preview described in tools/kide-live-preview.
